title: QMiso Marinated Duck Fat Wrap
description: A funky and dense Algerian-inspired brunch dish featuring duck fat marinated in miso for a raw-friendly, bento-box presentation.

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.amount: a small piece, peeled and grated finely

instructions: Combine miso paste, ginger, sesame seeds, lemon juice, water, and salt in a mixing bowl. Mix well until the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Pour the miso marinade over duck fat in a small baking dish. Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes to allow flavors to infuse into the fat.
Let the marinated duck fat cool before using as a wrap base in your bento box.
Slice or break the cooled marinated duck fat into bite-sized pieces and use them as wraps for your meal.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
